description: Where this host connected out to, aggregated per destination per hour. Raw connections are far too many to keep and the aggregate is what gets investigated — 'this address, this port, this often' is the question anyone actually asks.

fields.label: Process
fields.description: Named process_name, not process: a DocField called `process` shadows frappe.model.meta.Meta.process() when the DocType is built, and the migration dies with 'NoneType object is not callable'.

fields.label: Times Seen
fields.description: How many scans saw this destination in this hour. A beacon that keeps failing shows up here as a high count that never became useful.

fields.label: Never Connected
fields.description: Seen only in SYN-SENT. The incident's beacon looked exactly like this — retrying forever because its destination had already been blocked.

name: Outbound Connection Summary
